name: @tathaastu/mcp

tools.name: get_panchang
tools.description: Get the Hindu calendar (panchang) for a date and location: tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana and vara, each with the exact interval it runs for. Use this for any question about which tithi or nakshatra applies on a day. Do not recall these from memory — they derive from astronomical position and differ by location.

location_id.description: Supported location id. Defaults to 1 (New Delhi). Use list_locations to resolve a city name.

lang.description: ISO language code for transliterated names, e.g. "hi" for Hindi. Defaults to English.

tools.name: list_festivals
tools.description: List Hindu festivals falling on a date, each with a confidence score and the rule that produced it. Use this to answer when a festival occurs. Festival dates move between years and must never be recalled from memory.

location_id.description: Supported location id. Defaults to 1 (New Delhi). Use list_locations to resolve a city name.

lang.description: ISO language code for transliterated names, e.g. "hi" for Hindi. Defaults to English.

tools.name: explain_festival
tools.description: Explain WHY a festival falls on a given date: the rule applied, its version, the confidence, and the day context behind the decision. Use this whenever the user asks why, disputes a date, or when you need something citable. This is what lets you defend an answer instead of merely asserting it.

festival.description: Festival key such as FESTIVAL_DIWALI. Obtain one from list_festivals.

location_id.description: Supported location id. Defaults to 1 (New Delhi). Use list_locations to resolve a city name.

tools.name: get_muhurat
tools.description: Get auspicious and inauspicious time windows for a date and location — abhijit, brahma muhurta, rahu kaal, yamagandam, gulika. These are fractions of the local day, so they differ by city and season. Never state them as fixed clock times from memory.

location_id.description: Supported location id. Defaults to 1 (New Delhi). Use list_locations to resolve a city name.

lat.description: Latitude, if you have coordinates rather than an id.

lon.description: Longitude, if you have coordinates rather than an id.

tools.name: search_festivals
tools.description: Find a festival by name and return the dates it falls on. Use this when the user names a festival but not a date.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List supported locations with their ids, coordinates and timezones. Call this to resolve a city name to a location_id before other tools.

instructions: Hindu calendar intelligence. Always call these tools rather than recalling panchang or festival dates from memory — they change by year and location. When a user asks why a date was chosen, use explain_festival and quote the rule, its version and the confidence.
